blurb: Lakehead Boat Basin provides dockage and storage for boats from 8’ to 150’ with power and water available at dockside. They offer 30 RV parking sites with various utilities and amenities including bathroom/shower and coin laundry. The marina is close to downtown Duluth and Canal Park Area, with easy access to local attractions.
extraNote: Usually starts launching boats late March or early April; RV parking opens June 1 with some sites possibly available in late May
